propositions: _iter_pages terminates on a short page and advances by the requested page_size, so a server-capped first page ends the scan early and silently drops issues from the inbound snapshot.
A Jira Data Center instance serving 250 issues while capping each page at 20 yields only 20 of 250 recovered (92% lost), and a run in this state still reports converged success.
The fix advances by len(page) and terminates only on an empty page, matching the earlier correction applied to get_parent_map (change 1105).

An offset-stall guard must raise SilentTruncationError instead of looping when a server ignores startAt and returns the same non-empty page repeatedly, distinct from the existing same-token-twice cursor-stall guard.
The change lives in core fetcher.py on the shared inbound path so it reaches the Cloud bridge, and must be verified safe for Cloud, leaving cap and ACLI-ceiling semantics unchanged.
The stall check must run before yielding so duplicate pages never reach the caller and drive duplicate writes in a dry-run pass.
